Name: Custom NPC - March from Fields of Mistria
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Mom: We have March FoM at home
March FoM at home:

March is the apprentice of Clint and lives at the blacksmith.

Currently not marriageable, but heart events and dialogue are written romantically.

Early dialogue and cutscenes are partially based on dialogue from FoM with some modification, but later ones are unique.

Latest Update:
Added 4 heart event
Added seasonal sprites and portraits
Mod no longer replaces Clint, adds March as his apprentice instead
Added festival dialogue
Added dialogue to other villagers to talk about March
Updated schedule
Added dialogue
Moved previous 6 heart event to 8 hearts


Feel free to comment any problems/suggestions!

Character Info:

Likes/Dislikes:
Love: Gold bar, iridium bar, maki roll, star shard
Like: Copper bar, iron bar, coffee, chocolate cake, beer, gold ore, copper ore, fried eel
Dislike: flowers
Hated: red mullet

Heart Events:
2 hearts - After reaching 2 hearts, March will send you a letter. After reading the letter, enter the blacksmith's while it's open.
4 hearts - Enter the blacksmith's while its open
6 hearts - To be added
8 hearts - Enter the town between 8pm-midnight.
10 hearts - After reaching 10 hearts, March will send you a letter. After reading the letter, go to the mountain after 7pm.
